record.body:
## Description

Make execute-phase require a commit per task on the phase branch before verify so a passing check-run can carry a real SHA.

## Approach

1. Update `skills/execute-phase/SKILL.md` so that after each task's code lands (and before verify for that task), the executor commits on the phase branch when Landing is present.
2. Add or extend tests (`tests/test_task_commit.py` and/or `tests/test_execute_landing.py`) that fail if that rule is missing from the skill.
3. Do not edit the contract, CLI, or verify-work in this task.
